text: Every person in the Power BI service holds one of three licenses — and what you can actually do depends on more than just which one.
Free lets you build for yourself, nothing more. Pro adds sharing and collaboration with other Pro users. Premium Per User adds most Premium features, but only shareable with other PPU users.

Here's the part people miss: a Free user can view shared content, but only if that content lives in a workspace assigned to a Premium or Fabric capacity. The license alone never decides this — where the workspace lives decides it too.
Microsoft Fabric is the umbrella platform now housing Power BI alongside these other tools, all sharing one capacity. A Fabric F64 or larger capacity does everything a Power BI Premium capacity did.
Once you know what your license allows, Lesson 69 puts you inside your first real workspace.
